MOVE MAXIMUM TILES

Skill Move is included in the Skill cost and is independent of ordinary walking. Its authored distance, legal terrain, Jump, occupancy and Root still apply. Basic Move retains its own execution price and Movement allowance.

Walk across legal Ground tiles before follow-up effects, as part of the skill's overall cost and using the position actually reached.
